resources.string: Imvamisa ye-GPU, imikhawulo ephansi nephezulu, nokulawula okuzenzakalelayo.
Ukulawula imvamisa akutholakali. Ukufundwa kuboniswa uma kunikezwa umshayeli.

Khetha imvamisa ebikwe yile divayisi. Imodi engaguquki ingase yeqe imikhawulo yemvamisa ye-GPU ebekwa isofthiwe ngenxa yokushisa. Imvamisa engaguquki ingakhuphula ukusetshenziswa kwamandla nezinga lokushisa. Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza uma i-GPU isebenza; i-GPU isengacisha lapho ingasebenzi.
Susa imikhawulo yemvamisa ye-GPU oyibeke ngesandla nemodi engaguquki, bese uvumela isistimu ukuthi iphinde ikhethe imvamisa.

Ukuqalisa kabusha kubuyisela ukulawula kwe-GPU okuzenzakalelayo. Lezi zilawuli azishintshi izilungiselelo ze-CPU. Imikhawulo yemvamisa eceliwe nesebenzayo iboniswa ngokwehlukana; imvamisa yamanje ivela kumshayeli.
Ukulawula i-GPU okuceliwe akutholakali. Vula leli khasi kabusha bese uzama futhi.
Lo mshayeli we-GPU akakusekeli ukulawula okuceliwe.
Le divayisi ayisayibiki leyo mvamisa. Khetha elinye lamanani atholakalayo manje.
Umshayeli we-GPU wenqabile ushintsho. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzamile ukubuyisela isilungiselelo sangaphambilini.
Isilungiselelo se-GPU esiceliwe asikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzamile ukubuyisela isilungiselelo sangaphambilini.
%1$s Isilungiselelo se-GPU sangaphambilini asikwazanga ukubuyiselwa. Buyisela ukulawula okuzenzakalelayo noma uqale kabusha ifoni.

Khetha inani eliphansi neliphezulu ezimvamiseni ezibikwa yile divayisi. I-GPU ingashintsha imvamisa phakathi kwebanga elisebenzayo futhi icishe uma ingenzi lutho. Inani eliphansi elibekwe phezulu lingadlula eminye imikhawulo yokushisa yesofthiwe futhi landise ukushisa nokusetshenziswa kwamandla.
Imvamisa ephansi ayikwazi ukudlula imvamisa ephezulu.
Esinye isilawuli sishintshe izilungiselelo ze-GPU. Isilungiselelo saso sishiywe singashintshiwe.
Imikhawulo eceliwe yizilungiselelo zakho. Imikhawulo esebenzayo yibanga umshayeli alisebenzisayo manje ngemva kokuhlanganisa izicelo zazo zonke izilawuli.
Imvamisa ye-GPU engaguquki iyasebenza. Ukusebenzisa ibanga kususa imodi engaguquki futhi kuvumele i-GPU ukuthi ishintshe imvamisa phakathi kwemikhawulo esebenzayo.
